Description

Waterlow Park boasts top quality outdoor tennis courts that are perfect for tennis fans in and around North London. It caters for beginners, intermediates and expert tennis players in equal measure. This facility has hard (macadam) tennis courts and these are looked after impeccably to ensure there are no untoward bounces during a crucial point. The tennis courts at Waterlow Park are well kept with the lines and markings clearly visible. Tennis is a great sport as it caters for various formats. Singles is the most popular, but if you have four players keen for a knockabout then doubles is a thrilling game to play.

The venue operates a pay and display parking system. Those keen on driving to the facility should remember to bring change for the machine. Midweek evenings and weekends are the busiest times so please be aware that parking availability will be tougher to secure during these times.

The venue is open to the public to come and play on a one off basis. Their pay as you play system means that you can book now and play without being a member. This gives you the freedom to play a one off game without having to pay a monthly membership fee.

Looking to set up regular games at Waterlow Park? Enquire about making a block booking to ensure you secure the time slot you want to play at every week. Block bookings are perfect for teams who want to be assured that they'll be playing regularly. A block booking is a booking made for a set number of consecutive weeks, on average this is 10 weeks.

If you're looking to travel using public transport, then the nearest station is Archway. This facility has excellent public transport links making it easy for all participants to reach the venue.
